title: Kubernetes Pod and container states
summary: Distinguish Pod phase, container state, readiness and backoff conditions.

concepts.title: Pod phase
concepts.explanation: Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed and Unknown are broad lifecycle summaries.

concepts.title: Container state
concepts.explanation: Waiting, Running and Terminated describe individual containers.

concepts.title: Readiness
concepts.explanation: A Running Pod can still be unready; readiness is separate from phase.

concepts.title: Backoff condition
concepts.explanation: CrashLoopBackOff reports repeated restart backoff, not the underlying cause.

limitations: Phase is not a complete application-health signal.
Managed platforms and custom controllers can add context beyond standard fields.
